notes: The %iso2 macro is the continuous-outcome (depression score) counterpart to the paper's isotemporal substitution logistic models: a survey-weighted proc surveyreg regression on the same daily time-use covariate set. Model spec, class list, and macro body kept verbatim; the KCYPS2018 survey extract was replaced with 60 rows of synthetic time-use + weight data matching the 20 columns the script expects.
